So this happened a couple years ago, when I was young and dumb. So I would take the bus home from work everyday and across the street from my stop was a psychic store. It was on a corner lot and the windows had signs saying, "hand reading inside!" and "know your future" and all that. Well I don't really believe in psychics, but I do have faith in all the cool stuff they use. You know rocks to give you energy and little statues of different dieties and whatnot. I think that stuff is pretty cool, so I think to myself, man I bet they have a bunch of cool shit in there! So one day after work I got off my bus, walked across the street and walked into the psychic store. Upon entering I stopped dead in my tracks, it looked I had walked into someones living room. To the left of me were sofas and a tv entertainment system where a little girl (5 yrs old ish) was sitting there watching some cartoon. To the right of me was a dining table. So I just stood there and stared at the girl who stared back at me, 2 seconds later her mom (the psychic) comes out of a room down the hall and asks if I need any help. Confused, I let her know I thought this was a psychic store where they sold stuff. She told me no, she only did psychic readings and such there. I said oh ok cool and tried to slip away, but she started going on about psychic readings and if I would like to try one, and of course being interested I was like sure, why the hell not!

Well she went and gave me a free palm reading and then went on to say that there was bad stuff coming up in my life and someone was trying to hurt me and she could do this thing where she lights a candle and 3 days later she can see who will hurt me. I was like sure that sounds cool! But it costs like $100 and I'm like not cool! So I declined, but she was insistent, and I still declined, so she said ok! Well how bout you clean my bathroom and I'll do it for you! And I'm like ok define clean? She says wipe down the mirror (one wall was a mirror, totally weird), wipe down the sink/countertop, scrub out the toilet (with scrub brush), and sweep and mop. So I'm like ok, why the hell not. So I do it, and it takes me about 45 min. When I am done she says ok, I'll get started on the candle thing tonight, blah, blah, blah come back in 3 days. As I am leaving though her husband comes home with the baby and their son (8 ish). I get introduced, she tells him all about how someone is after me and she is going to find out, blah, blah, blah. And he says, yeah, yeah, and then procedes to get all pissy because the babysitter called off and she is the one who does the laundry for the week, so now they have no clean clothes. The psychic went on to tell me that they don't have a washer and dryer and this babysitter did it at her house for them since they couldnt afford a laundry mat. So I was like hey I'm coming back in 3 days, why I don't I just do your laundry for you (totally dumb thing to say on my part, but I was thinking of being a good person and helping them out). And they were like no we need it today, and I was like well..... and they said how about we go to a laundry mat and just spend the money this one time, and I am like ya good idea. But then the husband was like oh by we, I mean you, because he has to take this kid here, and that kid there, and he doesn't have time. Then the psychic starts talking all sweet to me and because I am a big guillable dummy, I said ok I'll go to the laundrymat for you and do your laundry.

So the husband gets the minivan all packed up and I was like wtf am I doing, but am too embarressed to back out now. So I hop in the mini van and am enternally freaking out, the husband was weird and I thought of every kidnapping/horror movie I have seen, but the kids came too so that made me feel better. Usually killers and such won't take their kids with them if they are going to kill (at least thats not how it happens in hollywood). So we start driving to the laundrymat and it's like 15 minutes away, and I'm thinking fuck, I don't have a car, so by the time I get back from this laundry mat it will be dark and I will have to walk from the psychic store to my house in a bad part of town by myself. But being me, I'm like well I'll deal with that later. So We get to the laundry mat and we unpack the laundry, it was 5 loads, and the husband explains to me that this kid has this allergy so he uses this soap, and this kid uses that soap, and blah, blah, blah. Then he leaves and says I'll be back in 2 hrs. He also wanted me to fold T,T

So I call my boyfriend freaking out and tell him where I'm at and he gets super pissed and starts freaking me out cause its unsafe and all that, and I'm like my bad! So him and one of our good friends came right away. So being the girl I am, I start crying and freaking out, but I'm doing these peoples laundry cause I;'m like lets get it the fuck over with. So my bf and friend have school that night so they can only stay for like 20min. So my bf leaves me his car keys (I don't even have my liscence) and tells me he wants me to drive myself home and have a safe escape if anything happens. So this was a huge relief and I felt better. Than they left and I stuck by my word and continued the laundry.

BUT! I had their clothes spread out and this was at sun down, so it was suuuuuuuper busy. And I totally took out the wrong persons load thinking it was the psychic families.So I was sitting there folding some random guy's clothes and the husband of the psychic comes in. I'm like oh great hi! I'm not done (I already had 4 bags done, 1 left). And he is like oh no, thank you for helping I got out early blah, blah, blah. And as this is going on the random guy is freaking out and yelling at the laundry mat lady because his clothes are missing. They start investigating and finally make their way to my table and he freaks out on me for taking his clothes, I apologize, but he keps going, and the laundry lady starts lecturing me about the rules, and I'm trying to explain myself, but of course I make no sense. I tell them listen I got confused because I'm doing laundry for this guy and I don't know what kind of clothes he has and I thought this was the batch and the guy is like no this is mine, and the lady is threatning to kick me out for breaking the rules, and they were both loud and just going off, and the psychics husband turns to them apologizes, and points to me and does the crazy signal with his other hand. The one where you point a finger at your head and rotate it in a small circle. And the people got wide eyed and quieted down. And I got SUUUUUUUUPER pissed, he then is like come on were leaving, and he grabs a bag and throws it at me and is like come on lets load up the car. So I hold back tears and carry it to the car, as I put the bag in the car, he goes back to get another one and I just turned around and walked to my bf's truck and drove away.

Thats pretty much it. I was really emotional on the ride home and was crying. I was also freaking out cause I didn't have a drivers liscence. But luckily I lived closeby and took the back roads and got home ok. My bf was really relieved and gave me a stern talking to. All my friends were like wtf? lol But the worse thing about it was having to sit across from her psychic house at the bus stop every morning omw to work thinking about the awkward convo that would take place next we meet. She eventually came out like 3 months later and walked across the street and just said hi, how are you? And that was that. I haven't seen or heard from her since! But I learned my lesson and am not that timid any more!

TLDR: Agreed to clean bathroom for psychic lady for a psychic reading, got bamboozled into doing her laundry at a laundry mat, and while doing her laundry, her husband told the whole place I was crazy and made me cry.

Hello to whoever decides to read all of this,

I dealt with some pretty serious depression when I was younger. I lived with the dreaded feeling that I was never going to be good enough, never going to amount to anything, and never going to matter. Suicide entered my thoughts several times over the years, but never went through with it for two reasons; fear and embarrassment. That second one is strange to me, even to this day. One of the things that drove me deeper into my depression was the thought that I didn't "deserve" to be depressed. There were people out there who had it much worse than I. It's strange to think that something that fed my depression also kept me alive. I remember asking (or rather telling) myself that nobody would believe I was depressed, people would scoff at the idea and mock my passing. I didn't want to embarrass myself or my family.

I actively fought these feelings and thoughts daily for about 8 years. It wasn't until I was in college, had a break down, and considered throwing myself into traffic that I admitted I needed help. I couldn't do this on my own any more. I went to counselling. It helped. He gave me hope. He was an ear to talk to, another person who was asking for me to talk and tell my story. I poured my heart out in the first meeting. I cried, hard, for over thirty minutes. At the end, he looked at me and said "You're much stronger than you think." Those words meant and do mean a lot to me to this day. He did not necessarily save my physical life that day, but he certainly did save how I viewed my life.

I look back and honestly have to thank depression. It has made me a stronger person. It forced me to look inward and ask myself some difficult questions. I appreciated the random smile I got from a passerby more than any one person should because it meant someone noticed my existence. I learned who I was as a teenager, not as a 20 something. I have grown to appreciate everything that I am today because I spent so much of my time exploring my mind and body.

Now to the actual point of this post. I am sitting here writing this, more as a sort of self therapy session, because I feel sad. There is not an apparent reason for my sadness. Nothing happened today to make me sad. In fact, its a Friday, I should be happy today of all days out of the week. But I cannot help but feel sad. I have the feeling of despair, as if there is a dementor floating near by preventing me from feeling any happiness. This happens from time to time. It is irritating and scary. I feel defenseless against my own mind. It is exhausting to have to keep my guard up on the regular. Not against the outside world but against my own self. Am I alone in experiencing this? Am I alone in having a life that should make me happy but ultimately still have these bouts of depression? I feel alone, I feel like I can't talk to anyone about it. I feel that if I reach out and talk to someone, they will scoff and judge me for being so dramatic.

If you have made it this far, thank you for taking time to read my thoughts.

Hey, I know it's been a while since you posted this, but I just wanna say that I'm in the same boat as you. It's currently a normal, regular Friday night and I'm sitting here trying not to cry. Like you, I have no "reason" for it - I have a pretty good life, family, relationship etc. Unfortunately depression doesn't always care about how normal or good your life is.

So yeah... You're definitely not alone, and you deserve to get help and to feel better. I hope you're doing alright.
